lens: Migration — upgrade path, deprecation window, breaking-change handling
answer: PR #18 executes a 222-file specs-topology flatten + ADR-0119 + 34 git-renames in one commit (verified on origin/dev per M1). The migration is ATOMIC and bisect-safe at the git layer (-M detects renames, blame preserved), but it ships ZERO deprecation window: any consumer hardcoding specs/cross-cutting/<file>.json paths breaks at the merge instant with no symlink, alias, or forwarding shim. ADR-0119 omits Sunset/Reversal section (per A2 BLOCK + F10 medium). docs/CHANGELOG.md has no entry for the topology shift (per A2). For internal consumers PR #18 self-rewrites all references in same commit (lockstep), so internal breakage is bounded — but external consumers (forks, downstream agents reading via raw GitHub URLs, CI in sibling repos) get no warning.
key_claims: M1 verified on origin/dev: 34 git renames present (R088-R100 similarity); flat files exist; specs/cross-cutting/ depopulated
ADR-0119 documents the migration but omits the Sunset/Reversal section that ADR template TPL-ADR-v2 mandates
No CHANGELOG.md entry — the 222-file topology shift is invisible to anyone reading the repo's release log
No symlink/alias/forwarding shim — old paths return ENOENT immediately at merge
lifecycle-configs/ subdirectory retained as documented exception in ADR-0119 — properly carved out
_migrated_from breadcrumb metadata absent on moved JSONs (per M2 finding)
PR body explains supersession of #14 but says nothing about external-consumer impact
uncertainty_areas: Whether any external repo or fork actually hardcodes specs/cross-cutting/* paths — out-of-repo scan deferred
Whether the broader oyatie ecosystem (bominal, parallel codebases) consume oyatie spec paths via raw URLs
Whether ADR-0019 doc-update protocol's CHANGELOG requirement is enforced or advisory

findings.summary: Public path rename ships with zero deprecation window. Any external consumer (fork, downstream agent, sibling repo CI) hardcoding /specs/cross-cutting/<file>.json gets ENOENT at the merge instant.
findings.recommended_action: Either (a) restore old paths as symlinks for one milestone before deletion, or (b) add a forwarding-shim JSON at each old path containing {"deprecated":true,"moved_to":"/specs/<file>.json","sunset_at":"2026-08-15"} read by spec resolvers. Document the choice in ADR-0119.

findings.summary: ADR-0119 omits Sunset/Reversal section (concurrent with A2 BLOCK + F10 finding). For a topology change touching 222 files, the rollback runbook is non-optional.
findings.recommended_action: Amend ADR-0119 with Sunset/Reversal section enumerating: git revert <merge-sha>, post-revert CI lane invocation (oya-check-spec-paths), data-loss confirmation note (none expected since git mv preserves blame).

findings.summary: docs/CHANGELOG.md has no entry for the 222-file topology shift. ADR-0019 update protocol requires CHANGELOG entries for material structural changes.
findings.recommended_action: Add CHANGELOG entry under 2026-05-16: 'BREAKING: specs/cross-cutting/ flattened to specs/ root per ADR-0119; external consumers must update path references; lifecycle-configs/ retained as typed exception.'

findings.summary: _migrated_from breadcrumb metadata not added to moved JSON files. Future debuggers cannot trace path lineage from the file alone.
findings.recommended_action: Add _meta._migrated_from: '/specs/cross-cutting/<file>.json' field to each moved JSON during the next routine edit cycle.
